1. What was decided or left unfinished yesterday (check memory and the vault daily note).
2. Anything time-sensitive you know about.
3. One thing worth his attention that he hasn't asked about.
Be brief. No preamble, no filler. If there is nothing meaningful to report, say so in one line.

Morning, Dra. Here's where things stand — Thursday, 6 Aug 2026.

**Voice mode — closest to done, one gap left.** Speech quality is fixed (mojibake, markdown read aloud, dead air between sentences — all sorted yesterday). What's blocking a real `milo voice` mic session: no GEMINI key in `$MILO_HOME/.env` (only the artisan pipeline has one) and sounddevice/ffmpeg on PATH. Edge TTS is the default speaker, so the main missing piece is the mic input + a key. Once it's live, we wire the identity check (passphrase before sensitive actions) before real use — that was the deal.

**Hermes absorption roadmap** — voice is #1 and nearly there. Next up when you're ready: #2 cron/webhooks (kill the schtasks dependency), then #3 the broken browser/computer-use fix.

**YouTube replication** — one engine, five channels (Money Matrix, ExplaiNation, god did fx, moviegasm, flick rush), heavy-twist at ScriptEngineer. The open piece is building the fetch-transcript step so you drop in a URL and get a twisted script out. The fetch_transcript.py you wanted is already in the Hermes repo, ready to vendor in.

**Website flip** — plan locked: global prospects, one-off sale, Gmail outreach, cheap hosting. Design bar set (Hortons-level, real photos, no Picsum). El Dorado and Rockford Lane are blacklisted styles permanently. Next real step is prospect hunting — pulling businesses off Google Maps with their real info and branding.

My suggested day: either finish the voice gap (I need a Gemini key from you, or we wire sounddevice) or point me at a channel URL and I'll build the transcript-scraping step. Both are an hour of work, not a project.
